$schema.description: Optional JSON Schema path for editor validation.

defaultMachine.description: Machine key from `swarm.json` that claims tasks for this project when no `machine=<name>` label is specified, or "any".

baseBranch.description: Default Git base branch used when creating task branches or worktrees.

repo.description: Optional GitHub repository in "owner/repo" format (auto-detected from `origin` remote and advertised in `#swarm/registry` so Lead can inspect it read-only via `gh` when clarifying ambiguous requests).

useWorktree.description: Optional per-project override for `workerDefaults.useWorktree`. Set `true` to allow multiple concurrent workers on this single repo via Git worktrees.

enabled.description: Enable or disable automated code review for this project. Defaults to true when a project `reviewer` override block is specified without `enabled: false`.

agent.description: Per-project reviewer agent profile override (e.g. "pi", "codex", "claude", "agy", or a custom profile key).

model.description: Per-project reviewer model override (use "" to inherit the chosen agent profile's default model).

skipIfNoDiff.description: Per-project override for skipping review when there are no Git changes.

reviewer.description: Optional per-project reviewer override. Omitted fields inherit `workerDefaults.reviewer` from `config/swarm.json`.

paths.description: Map of machine keys from `swarm.json` to absolute local repository paths.

additionalProperties.description: Repository metadata and per-machine checkout paths for a single `#projects/<slug>` queue.

projects.description: Registry mapping project slugs (matching `#projects/<slug>` Vercel Board channels) to local paths and defaults.
